S.FORM: makasi-ini ia, tee=ku pu-a-iisua c<um>a-capa ʔalam mata vutukulu.
S.PHON: makaʂiini ia teeku puaiisua ʦumaʦapa ʔaɾam mata vutukuɾu
S.FORM: makasiini ia, teeku puaiisua c<um>acapa 'aram mata vutukuru.
S.PHON: makaʂiini ia teeku puaiisua ʦumaʦapa ʔa[r|ɾ]am mata vutuku[r|ɾ]u
S.TRANSL: I want to talk about roasting meat and fish now.

S.FORM: sua ʔalam ia, nuu tee=ci capa-ən ia, ma-staan ma-manəŋ ia, carəʔə.
S.PHON: sua ʔaɾam ia nuu teetʂi ʦapaən ia mastaan mamanəŋ ia ʦarəʔə
S.FORM: sua 'aram ia, nuu teeci capaen ia, mastaan mamaneng ia, care'e.
S.PHON: sua ʔa[r|ɾ]am ia nuu teetʂi ʦapaen ia mastaan mamaneŋ ia ʦa[r|ɾ]eʔe
S.TRANSL: When roasting meat, it's best to sprinkle salt on it.
After sprinkling salt, we just roast it.
Fish is done in the same way.

S.FORM: nuu tee=kasu mati-manəŋ vutukulu ia, maka-sua carəʔ-ən ka-vaŋvaŋ.
S.PHON: nuu teekasu matimanəŋ vutukuɾu ia makasua ʦarəʔən kavaŋvaŋ
S.FORM: nuu teekasu matimaneng vutukuru ia, makasua care'en kavangvang.
S.PHON: nuu teekasu matimaneŋ vutuku[r|ɾ]u ia makasua ʦa[r|ɾ]eʔen kavaŋvaŋ
S.TRANSL: If you want the fish to taste delicious, you need to sprinkle salt all over it.
Having sprinkled salt on it, (you) roast (the fish) until it is dried.

S.FORM: nuu tu-rupaŋ-an=ci c<um>apa ia, ala-ən=cu əm-əsəʔə pu-ʔucipi=ci=kia cunuku.
S.PHON: nuu turupaŋantʂi ʦumapa ia aɾaənʦu əməsəʔə puʔutʂipitʂikia ʦunuku
S.FORM: nuu turupanganci c<um>apa ia, araencu emese'e pu'ucipicikia cunuku.
S.PHON: nuu tu[r|ɾ]upaŋantʂi ʦumapa ia a[r|ɾ]aenʦu emeseʔe puʔutʂipitʂikia ʦunuku
S.TRANSL: When the roasting is done, we put it aside and cook rice cake.
When the rice cake is ready, we cook the fish (with sauce).

S.PHON: paatiʔau na vutukuɾu mariuʦuuʦu ʔpʂi misai
paatiʔau na vutuku[r|ɾ]u ma[r|ɾ]iuʦuuʦu ʔpʂi misai
S.TRANSL: We dip (the rice cake) in the fish broth and suck it (in the mouth).
